newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.54 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.54 pct lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 0.54 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 475.92 points, down from 478.52 on Wednesday.
Total volume was 1.15 million dinars against 967,146 dinars over the previous session.
UBCI bank fell 0.9 dinar to 45 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole slid 0.8 dinar to 25.76. Banque du Sud was down 0.77 dinar to 24.83 dinars.

Milk firm Tunisie Lait eased 0.72 dinar to 23.74 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia edged lower 0.52 dinar to 45. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel declined 0.52 dinar to 10.48 dinars. Insurance firm ASTREE was down 0.4 dinar to 25.6. Investment fund Placement de Tunisie eased 0.36 dinar to 11.62 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels edged lower 0.27 dinar to 10.5. Chemical firm ICF was down 0.2 dinar to 56 dinars. Airline Tunis Air declined 0.16 dinar to 23.7 with 6,638 shares changing hands.
